tasks.label: Analysis: configure dualcore Pico 2
tasks.command:
set -e
sdk="${env:PICO_SDK_PATH}"
test -f "$sdk/pico_sdk_init.cmake" || { echo "PICO_SDK_PATH is not set to a Pico SDK" >&2; exit 1; }
root="${workspaceFolder}/../.."
board=pico_dualcore
out="$root/BUILD/analysis/$board"
if [[ -d "$out" ]]; then cmake -E remove_directory "$out"; fi
cmake -S "${workspaceFolder}" -B "$out" -G Ninja \
  -DPICO_SDK_PATH="$sdk" \
  -DPICO_BOARD=$board \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
cmake --build "$out" --target harness-probe
ln -sfn "$out" "${workspaceFolder}/build"
echo "==> compile_commands.json: ${workspaceFolder}/build/compile_commands.json"

tasks.label: Analysis: switch active board
tasks.command:
set -e
board=${input:analysisBoard}
root="${workspaceFolder}/../.."
out="$root/BUILD/analysis/$board"
if [[ ! -f "$out/compile_commands.json" ]]; then
  echo "==> 该板卡还没配置过，请先运行对应的 Analysis: configure 任务" >&2
  exit 1
fi
ln -sfn "$out" "${workspaceFolder}/build"
echo "==> clangd DB 切换为: $board （在命令面板运行 clangd: Restart language server 使其生效）"

background.endsPattern: Info : Listening on port 3333 for gdb connections

inputs.description: 选择 clangd 使用的板卡 (compile_commands.json)
